candidates.issuing_authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
candidates.geographic_applicability_evidence: Central Sector scheme for eligible farmer families identified by State and UT administrations.

candidates.application_process_evidence: Official portal exposes New Farmer Registration and Know Your Status functions.
review_questions: Confirm the currently controlling guideline and revision date.
Confirm the complete current document set and all exclusion evidence.
Confirm whether recent portal notices alter eligibility processing.

candidates.application_process_evidence: Apply through MeeSeva centres according to the official FAQ.
review_questions: Obtain the current controlling TGMIP guidelines and effective dates.

Confirm whether document and area requirements have changed.
